column1: # sites.tsv: the inline Python sites in bin/ and hooks/ that import a bin/lib helper, and the epic that
# rewrites each. A site is a python3 -c '...' or a python3 - << heredoc in a file that is not a .py file.
# Each row is one (file, function, module). The function is the bash function holding the site, or (top)
# outside any. The module is one the site imports itself; what that module imports in turn is left out.
# n counts the sites in that function that import it. A site that imports modules of two epics goes to
# the later one of helpers-shared and helpers-panes.
# tests/port_sites_test.sh fails on a site with no row here.
